ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "WOMEN IN AMERICAN MUSIC." This course will examine the role of women in American music composition, performance, and education since the nineteenth century. Composers studied will include Amy Beach, Ruth Crawford, Florence Price, Ellen Taaffe Zwilich, Tania Leon, and Julia Wolfe. Additionally, we will look at gender and music patronage in American cultural institutions to the present. This course will take place fully online and asynchronously using Canvas. Meets with MUS 414.
